note: Gate-checkable projection of the QA Checklist in ../../SKILL.md (authoritative). type=python checks are computable via genie_textbook.py; type=manual require agent/render/citation inspection. OV-TEXT is also the default template for any title with no dedicated overlay.

GATE_1_post_phase0.text: Title Clearance Report issued; rating CLEAR or explained low-confusion CAUTION
Domain detected and mapped to one of the nine engine domains; panel configured; Engineering Directive activated if applicable
Subtitle locked; combined title+subtitle under 200 characters; compliance-checked
Audience, visual level, reference approach, assessment architecture, supplementary materials all locked with reasons
Two-color primary+accent pairing locked and collision-checked unique against the catalog
Opener style, section flow, feature-box names, close style locked and rotated vs prior titles
Pen name First M. Last, no honorifics, not reused, collision-screened
TOC complete with per-chapter image plan and page targets; Engineering: min 23 pp/chapter and 400-550 total confirmed arithmetically
Phase 0 gate passed per UAPF gate protocol

GATE_2_per_chapter.text: Opens in the locked opener style; 500-750 word opening; no narrative bullet lists
Learning Objectives box present, styled to spec; 3-5 Bloom-verb measurable objectives, each assessment/exposition traced
3-5 major numbered X.Y sections, headings bold ACCENT color, Times New Roman
All planned figures present at their exact points; captions beneath (max two lines); referenced in prose; white backgrounds verified
Engineering: every subchapter has its realistic photographic image, chapter is 23+ pages, NO practice questions anywhere
Non-Engineering: assessment items original, objective-mapped, numbered for the answer key
Every calculation recalculated; every value/unit/conversion checked; code tested where execution is claimed
Standards/guidelines cited with issuing body, edition, date; domain risk-regime language present
All cases fictional/de-identified; no copied prose/examples/structures; no em dashes
Feature boxes used per plan (3-5) under this book's custom names
Closes in the locked style (500-750 words) with narrative bridge; appended once, never regenerated

GATE_3_manuscript_complete.text: Front matter complete and ordered; roman/arabic numbering correct; TOC page numbers match layout
Discipline-adapted disclaimer on copyright page, extended with domain risk language
Answer key with worked solutions covers 100% of assessment items (where assessment exists); glossary, references, index, About the Author present
Citations-to-Verify ledger resolved or explicitly surfaced to the operator; zero fabricated citations
Objective-to-assessment (or exposition) trace audit passes book-wide
No drift from the locked signature; figure numbering continuous; list of figures/tables matches actuals
No third color anywhere; heading/box/table tints correct

GATE_4_release.text: PDF preflight: 8.5x11, 0.7in margins (plus gutter), fonts embedded, images 300 DPI at placed size, whites 255/255/255
eBook: linked TOC/NCX, no manual page numbers, tables reflow-safe
Metadata title/subtitle/author matches cover and interior; under 200 characters; category and keywords accurate
AI-disclosure status recorded per KDP policy; rights review clean (no logos, trade dress, copyrighted figures, real-person likenesses)
Final read of high-risk passages (medical/legal/engineering/financial) against the domain regime
Catalog log updated: title, pen name, color pairing, structural signature, marketplace, language
